company.name: Tough Commerce
company.shortDescription: Tough Commerce builds white-label order management and e-commerce tools for construction suppliers.
company.description: Tough Commerce (formerly Brokrete) platform allows suppliers to publish their branded app or web storefront to bring their operations online. It encompasses order management, payouts, dispatching logistics, and real-time delivery. With financial & operational ERP integrations, the Tough Commerce platform can operate stand-alone or seamlessly alongside deeply integrated products.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based platform for asset-based construction businesses to manage job scheduling, operator tracking, invoicing, and analytics in one system.
productsAndServices.name: All-in-One Job Management Software

productsAndServices.description: A branded mobile app allowing contractors to place orders, view tickets and invoices, and receive real-time updates independently.
productsAndServices.name: Contractor App (White-label Customer Portal)

productsAndServices.description: A scheduling and dispatch tool tailored for construction industries to manage orders, operators, and assets with drag-and-drop functionality.
productsAndServices.name: Dispatch and Scheduling System

productsAndServices.description: A driver-focused app and logistics tools for managing deliveries, tracking routes, and capturing proof of delivery digitally.
productsAndServices.name: Delivery Solutions (Driver App and Logistics Suite)

productsAndServices.description: A set of tools automating invoicing, e-ticketing, accounts receivable, payments, credit management, and sales tax compliance.
productsAndServices.name: Finance and Back-Office Automation Suite

productsAndServices.description: A payment processing system supporting credit cards, ACH, POS, credit terms, and flexible payment options integrated across the platform.
productsAndServices.name: Payment Solutions

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $1,495,568, or 31.99% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $4,266,926 to $14,497,153, a 3.4x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 51 (-3 over 90 days) and market heat at 60 (-3).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
